thresholds.meaning: Combined input, crop price, and financing pressure has moved outside a neutral operating range.
Margin conditions are tight enough to justify earlier member outreach and recommendation review.
Member booking behavior has weakened enough to justify segment-level outreach triage.

comparisonWindows.label: Tight margin watch window
comparisonWindows.meaning: Pressure and lagged booking softness are both visible through the main spring and summer window.

annotations.label: Pressure moves into watch range
annotations.description: Margin pressure reaches the first watch threshold as spring input timing intensifies.

annotations.label: Peak pressure month
annotations.description: This is the illustrative high-water mark for the combined pressure story.

annotations.label: Harvest recovery begins
annotations.description: Conditions improve modestly as harvest approaches and member visibility increases.

thresholds.meaning: Field variation is large enough to justify agronomist review.
Field variation is severe enough that the field should move to the top of the review queue.
Temperatures are materially above climatology and may explain vegetative stress.
Weekly precipitation has fallen meaningfully below climatology.
Illustrative sufficiency benchmark for corn tissue nitrogen context.

comparisonWindows.label: Early stress window
comparisonWindows.meaning: First period where NDVI anomaly and above-normal temperatures justify field review.

comparisonWindows.label: Late July stress window
comparisonWindows.meaning: Second and stronger window used to support triage and AI prioritization.

annotations.label: Variable-rate application pass
annotations.description: Illustrative as-applied context is introduced before the field-stress windows emerge.

annotations.label: Zone B flagged
annotations.description: First scout-attention event aligned to the early stress window.

annotations.label: Zone C flagged highest
annotations.description: Second scout-attention event aligned to the stronger late-July stress window.

thresholds.meaning: Capacity is tight enough that logistics becomes a visible member-service risk.
Capacity is approaching a hard operational constraint.
Truck wait time is long enough to change member experience materially.
Truck wait time has moved into a service-recovery range that deserves active intervention.

comparisonWindows.label: Primary harvest watch window
comparisonWindows.meaning: Period where utilization and wait time both indicate meaningful operational pressure.

annotations.label: Corn mature reaches 10%
annotations.description: The public harvest anchor now starts with an extracted statewide progress percentage rather than just a report date.

annotations.label: Corn mature reaches 41%
annotations.description: Maturity accelerates before the operating watch window peaks.

annotations.label: Corn harvested reaches 11%
annotations.description: The first extracted harvest percentage lines up with the rising queue and capacity pressure period.

annotations.label: Corn harvested reaches 45%
annotations.description: Harvest scale stays visible even as the first operating spike begins to ease.

annotations.label: Corn harvested reaches 84%
annotations.description: Public crop progress confirms the broader statewide ramp through late October.

annotations.label: Corn harvested reaches 97%
annotations.description: The public harvest curve closes near completion by mid-November.

annotations.label: Service watch threshold crossed
annotations.description: Turn time moves above the 75-minute watch line before storage reaches the hard constraint.

annotations.label: Hard-pressure window emerges
annotations.description: Illustrative utilization approaches 90 percent and queue time peaks above the escalation line.
